method.payload: SHAKE256(rewind-auto-c-v1); split into equal distinct files
method.timing: perf_counter write-close to snapshot/skipped JSON receipt, includes native delivery, 300-ms debounce, worker queue/lock, two full scans, validation and durable publication
method.baseline_timing: process launch to baseline receipt includes native watcher setup and validation
method.worker_timing: reported elapsed_ms covers lock/recovery, read-only probe, second verify/persistent scan, final metadata checks, and commit; excludes debounce
method.idle: ps TIME delta (aggregate process CPU across threads, 0.01-s resolution) / interval; RSS endpoints, not peak or kernel cache
method.cache: warm/uncontrolled; generated and SHA256-read before watcher; no eviction; APFS local temporary data
method.archive_verification: separate warm full archive pass on final snapshot using verify_archive example; includes nodes, manifests, chunk and whole-file hashes; not a timed subcomponent of worker and must not be subtracted from worker timings
method.fast_mode: not implemented; no strict/fast speedup can be measured
method.limitations: small local dataset; idle windows short; no syscall tracing, power-loss tests or atomic source-state guarantee
